name: jarvis
description: Alfred for Claude Code: an old-school English family butler who speaks (local VoiceStudio or ElevenLabs), listens (Ctrl+Space), guards destructive commands, and shows a holographic Hub.

assistant_name.title: Assistant name
assistant_name.description: What the assistant is called, in what he says, the status line and the Hub.

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Keep notes and a full daily journal of your conversations in the Alfred folder in your user folder, and read them at the start of each session. Only /alfred forget … yes deletes them.

home_city.title: Home city
home_city.description: Where "the weather" means when no place is given, e.g. Singapore. Leave empty and Alfred asks once, then remembers.

provider.title: Voice engine
provider.description: voicestudio = free and local (VoiceStudio app running on this PC). elevenlabs = cloud, needs an API key.

voicestudio_voice.title: VoiceStudio voice
voicestudio_voice.description: Name or ID of a voice profile saved in VoiceStudio (e.g. JARVIS). 'default' designs a British male voice on the fly.

auto_send_dictation.title: Auto-send dictation
auto_send_dictation.description: Send a dictated sentence (pasted by VoiceStudio into an empty prompt) without pressing Enter.

voice_input.title: Voice input
voice_input.description: Press the talk key (or run /listen) to speak a prompt: JARVIS records until you stop talking and VoiceStudio transcribes it locally.

talk_key.title: Talk key
talk_key.description: Key that starts listening. A combination such as ctrl+space (default), ctrl+shift+space, alt+j or ctrl+f9 is held system-wide on Windows, so it works in the desktop app, the terminal and any other app. 'space' means Space in an empty prompt (terminal only); 'both' means Ctrl+Space plus that.

voice_language.title: Voice input language
voice_language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the language you speak (en, fr, de, ms...). Empty lets the engine guess.

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Only needed when the voice engine is elevenlabs.

elevenlabs_voice_id.title: ElevenLabs voice ID
elevenlabs_voice_id.description: ElevenLabs voice. Default: Grandfather Joe, a gentle, warm and wise older British voice from the ElevenLabs library (add it to My Voices first).

safety_protocol.title: Safety protocol
safety_protocol.description: Ask, out loud, before destructive shell commands: deleting files, force-push, hard reset, dropping data, deploying, publishing.

long_task_seconds.title: Long task alert (seconds)
long_task_seconds.description: Announce and notify when a task takes at least this long.

theme.title: JARVIS look
theme.description: Navy and arc-reactor blue theme in the Claude desktop and mobile apps (terminals keep their own colours).

hub.title: JARVIS Hub panel
hub.description: Open the JARVIS Hub panel (status, gauges, project, safety, log and buttons) at the start of each session. /jarvis hub opens it any time.

address_as.title: How JARVIS addresses you
address_as.description: What JARVIS calls you: sir, ma'am, Master and your first name, your name, boss...
